newsitem.title: UK: BZW launches second UK endowment fund. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BZW launches second UK endowment fund. [CORRECTED 20:45 GMT]

text.p: Barclays Global Investors Limited will launch a second UK endowment fund to trade in with-profit endowment assurance policies aimed at financial intermediaries and private investors in the UK and abroad.

A statement from BZW said the fund will issue 25 million shares, 13.5 million of them placed and the balance on public offer. The offer opens today and closes on December 10. Dealing will start on the London Stock Exchange on December 18.
The closed-end fund will be registered in Jersey "for reasons of tax efficiency" and will repay the shares in five annual tranches in years nine to 13. The fund will be wound up in 2009.

"The repayment of capital over a five-year period rather than one bullet sum should enable investors to use their capital gains allowance over a five-year period," said Dan Nathanson at Barclays Global Investors.
The fund will invest in policies of different life offices, policy terms and maturity dates, purchasing second hand "on advantageous terms" through Absolute Assigned Policies.
Annual management charges on the fund are 1.2-percent and 2.0-percent commission will be paid to intermediaries.

Barclays Global Investors Group was formed by the merger of BZW Investment Management and Wells Fargo Nikko Investment Advisors earlier this year. It now manages and advises on around 240 billion stg (corrects from $230 billion) of assets worldwide.
